en: Keebo, what are you looking at?
Take a look at this.
These are...Kokichi's clothes?

<CLT=cltMIND>It's soaked and wrinkled, but there's
no doubt these are Kokichi's.

Where did you find this? I didn't see it
when I was investigating the bathroom.
And why are they soaked?

Well...the toilet seemed clogged, so I reached
my hand down the drain...

...and pulled out these clothes. It looks like
they couldn't be flushed all the way.
<CLT=cltMIND>Couldn't be flushed all the way...

Why were these clothes in
the toilet in the first place?

Yes, it was very brave of me. And thanks to
that, I managed to find an important clue.

Now, Shuichi...please investigate as much
as you want!
Ah...yeah...

<CLT=cltMIND>Clogging the toilet, huh...?
But this isn't the time to hesitate.

Because I was so brave, I managed to find
an important clue.

Now, Shuichi...please investigate as much
as you want!

<CLT=cltMIND>There's still some things I
should investigate here.
Yes
No
Are you unsure of something?
<CLT=cltSYSTEM>Would you like to leave?
<CLT=cltMIND>This is a small window for ventilation.
<CLT=cltMIND>This is the window from before.

<CLT=cltMIND>It's about eight inches wide,
and it won't open all the way.

<CLT=cltMIND>It's not possible for a person to
fit through there...
<CLT=cltMIND>But perhaps an <CLT=cltSTRONG>object<CLT=cltMIND> could.

There's nothing particularly off here,
but I want to investigate one more time.
<CLT=cltMIND>...
<CLT=cltMIND>...
<CLT=cltMIND>...

<CLT=cltMIND>It's no use.
There are no clues here.
<CLT=cltMIND>This crossbow is one from Maki's lab.
<CLT=cltMIND>Meaning...someone brought it here.
<CLT=cltMIND>This large black case...
<CLT=cltMIND>This is one from Maki's lab.

<CLT=cltMIND>There are arrows on the floor
of the bathroom...

<CLT=cltMIND>Three in total.
And...blood on all of them.

<CLT=cltMIND>...What does this mean?
I should investigate this again.
<CLT=cltMIND>...
<CLT=cltMIND>...
<CLT=cltMIND>...

<CLT=cltMIND>It's no use.
There are no clues here.

<CLT=cltMIND>There's a small bottle here.
It looks empty.

<CLT=cltMIND>The label has blood all over it,
I can't read it completely...
<CLT=cltMIND>but I can see the word "<CLT=cltSTRONG>poison<CLT=cltMIND>."

<CLT=cltMIND>It might not have necessarily come
from the <CLT=cltSTRONG>Ultimate Detective<CLT=cltMIND>'s lab...

<CLT=cltMIND>But with the <CLT=cltSTRONG>Strike-9 Poison<CLT=cltMIND> having less
in the bottle and the <CLT=cltSTRONG>antidotes<CLT=cltMIND> on the desk...
<CLT=cltMIND>It certainly can't be unrelated.
<CLT=cltMIND>Kokichi's clothes, found in the bathroom.

<CLT=cltMIND>If they were found in the toilet, someone
must have tried to flush them.
<CLT=cltMIND>But who would do that?

Is something the matter?
Please, investigate.
Ah! O-Okay!

<CLT=cltMIND>The <CLT=cltSTRONG>Ultimate Detective<CLT=cltMIND>
can't stop here!
<CLT=cltMIND>This *has* to be an important clue...
...Alright!

<CLT=cltMIND>I made up my mind, grabbed
Kokichi's soaked clothes...
<CLT=cltMIND>and spread them open.
...Huh?
<CLT=cltMIND>There's a small hole in the back.
<CLT=cltMIND>And another small hole on the sleeve.

<CLT=cltMIND>This is about the same size
as the one on Kaito's sleeve.

<CLT=cltMIND>There are traces of blood
around the holes, too.
<CLT=cltMIND>What does this mean?
<CLT=cltMIND>It could mean that he was attacked.
<CLT=cltMIND>In that case...
<CLT=cltMIND>

<CLT=cltMIND>There's a chance...Kokichi was the one
crushed in the hydraulic press!

Ah, Keebo, thank you! Thank you!
This is a very important clue!

Oh, I'm happy I was able to help, but I must
decline shaking that hand of yours.
Ah...your hands aren't clean either, though.

<CLT=cltSYSTEM>"<CLT=cltSTRONG>Kokichi's Clothes<CLT=cltSYSTEM>" has been added to the
Truth Bullets section of your Monopad.

<CLT=cltMIND>But if Kokichi was the one crushed
in the hydraulic press...

<CLT=cltMIND>Where did Kaito go?
Why not show himself?

<CLT=cltMIND>And why is this game still going,
even though the mastermind is dead?

Um... If this is awkward, Shuichi, I can leave
and give you some privacy...
You're...concerned about that?

<CLT=cltMIND>Keebo and I washed our
hands in the sink...
<CLT=cltMIND>...and left the bathroom.
<CLT=cltMIND>Kokichi's clothes, found in the bathroom.

<CLT=cltMIND>I believe Keebo is correct. Someone
tried to flush these clothes down the toilet.
<CLT=cltMIND>In that case, who did it?

<CLT=cltMIND>There's a small hole in the
back of these clothes...
<CLT=cltMIND>And another small hole on the sleeve.

<CLT=cltMIND>This is about the same size
as the one on Kaito's sleeve.

<CLT=cltMIND>There are traces of blood
around the holes, too.
<CLT=cltMIND>What does this mean?
<CLT=cltMIND>It could mean that he was attacked.

<CLT=cltMIND>Then, there's a chance that
Kokichi was crushed by the press.

<CLT=cltMIND>But if Kokichi was the one crushed
in the hydraulic press...

<CLT=cltMIND>Where did Kaito go?
Why not show himself?

<CLT=cltMIND>And why is this game still going,
even though the mastermind is dead?

<CLT=cltMIND>There's a pool of blood in the middle
of the bathroom, and a trail to the door.

What can I deduce from this bloodstain?
I should investigate again.
<CLT=cltMIND>...
<CLT=cltMIND>...
<CLT=cltMIND>...

<CLT=cltMIND>It's no use.
There are no clues here.
